card.title: How to reprogram the CD32 ROM with Wylie SPI Programmer

source.title: How to reprogram the CD32 ROM with Wylie SPI Programmer

claims.statement: A cheap Wylie SPI programmer can read/write the CD3217 ACE ROM as an alternative to the JCID tool; the ROM must be removed and soldered to the programmer with pin 1 matched.
If Detect shows nothing, suspect a bad solder joint or a dead ROM.

procedure: Desolder ROM and solder to programmer (pin 1 aligned).
Detect, select chip, open correct model dump, write.
Resolder the ROM to the board and test charging.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Soldering the ROM backwards can destroy it.
card.caveats: Driver, software and ROM dumps are third-party file-sharing links on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
